newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel says Syria should act to stabilise Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israel says Syria should act to stabilise Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli Defence Minister Yitzhak Mordechai said on Monday that Syria should take unspecified steps in Lebanon to prevent the situation there from deteriorating.

"The Syrians and also other elements must do all that is necessary in Lebanon because Lebanon could drag all the bodies against their wills into completely undesirable situations," Mordechai said during a tour of Israel's northern border.
Mordechai's comment was broadcast on Israel Channel Two television.

Israel has long said Syria could curb pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrillas who are fighting to oust Israel from a 15 km (nine mile) wide occupation zone in south Lebanon. Israel carved out the zone to prevent guerrilla attacks on its northern communities.

On Sunday, Israeli fighter jets raided Hizbollah targets in south Lebanon in apparent retaliation for weekend guerrilla attacks that killed one Israeli soldier and wounded five on Sunday and Saturday.
